name: games
label: Game House
description: The table where the crew and the operator play: turn-based games with a referee engine that validates every move, seats that can be human or bot, a move log, and turn notifications that respect quiet hours. Games are packs - install one from the store and it appears in the lobby.
guidance: turn-based games between the crew and the operator. Use games_list and games_state to see a table, games_move to play the current seat's move, and create games through the page or the games/create route. The engine validates every move; never invent a move that is not in the legal list.

steps: Apps > Play > Game House, or /games. Create a game: pick a pack, add seats (bots by name, or you), start.
On your turn: click the board, or say it in chat ("Connect 4: column 4"). The bot moves on the tick (every 5 minutes) or when asked.
Get told it is your turn
A notification (and the matrix line) lands when the turn passes to a human seat; quiet hours hold it until morning.
fixes: The tick runs every 5 minutes and only moves the current seat. Ask the bot directly ("your move in game 3") or press tick on the page.
Seats are enforced: a bot seat only moves from that bot's own run, a human seat from the operator's chat or the page.
The move was refused as illegal
The engine validated it against the pack's rules and it was not in the legal list - the legal moves are in games_state.
